lines.text: Step aside and let the real heroine show you how it's done.
Justice always prevails, and so do I!
All Nikkes are heroic. It's in our nature.
Birdie! Let's be heroes together!
As long as you trust me, I will never falter!

All Nikkes are heroes, and so are you!
So we will never lose!
Awaiting your orders... for quite some time now!

Let's roll out, Birdie! 
There are people who need our help!
It's always deafeningly loud over at the power station, but you won't hear me complaining. All that commotion means Maxwell is busy crafting weapons!
I'll ensure this place remains safe!
Anyone need a hero? If so, I'm your gal!
Don't freak out, but you've got the number one heroine with you now!
Oh! I'm feeling stronger now!
Not bad, you did good.
I know you've always got my back, Birdie!
You got this just for me? That's so nice of you!
Even though a true hero never expects anything in return, it's still a nice gesture.
This is almost as fun as giving a bad guy what for!
All right Birdie, I'm going to grant you the honor of having you accompany me on my heroic journey!
It's so strange... Being with you somehow makes me feel more heroic!

Birdie, thank you for everything you've done for me!
Now it's my turn to take care of you.
Here I come!
Point me to the bad guys!
I'm raring to go!
Encounter imminent! Get ready!
Don't you worry, I'll squash them all like bugs.
Those who block the path of the righteous will be shown no quarter!
I am an agent of justice.
Reloading!
You're tougher than I thought.
Even a hero needs to recharge once in a while!
Birdie!
C'mon everyone, let's score one for the good guys!
Give 'em everything you've got!
You can run, but you can't hide!
Justice has been served.
Who's next?
Uh.
Ugh.
Ow!
*Cough*Is this the end? Am I too weak?!
I told you justice would prevail!
